title: antirrhinum wislizeni
intro: Antirrhinum wislizeni, commonly known as the Arizona lophos, is a flowering plant species in the snapdragon family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Antirrhinum wislizeni include its use as a bronchodilator, helping to open airways and alleviate congestion, and its antimicrobial properties which can aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant have not been extensively studied, but it is likely that it contains iridoid glycosides and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
